sets.notes: `stampExempt` added by owner decision 2026-09-14 (DEC-710 sign-off, interaction 0dec0512). Clue Edition is an in-universe Ravnica product that carries the stamp because it is sold through mass-market retail, not because it is Universes Beyond — so the exemption is a statement about this set, and 4.3.5 itself is unchanged
